# Gauss Fit Coef

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

Fit nine samples of a Gaussian pulse with peak 5 at x=1 and standard deviation 2. Read the recovered center and amplitude.

## What this example demonstrates

Fit nine samples of a Gaussian pulse with peak 5 at x=1 and standard deviation 2. Read the recovered center and amplitude.
